name: Create Hamburger Writing Template
description:
An elementary school teacher needs a 'Hamburger Paragraph' visual aid to teach structured writing. Create a 3-page ActivInspire flipchart saved as '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/hamburger_paragraph.flipchart' with the following structure:

Page 1 — Title Page: Large text title 'Hamburger Paragraph'.

Page 2 — The Model: Create a visual diagram of a burger using the Shape tool. Stack shapes vertically to represent:
   - Top Bun (Shape) labeled 'Topic Sentence'
   - Filling 1 (Shape) labeled 'Detail 1'
   - Filling 2 (Shape) labeled 'Detail 2'
   - Filling 3 (Shape) labeled 'Detail 3'
   - Bottom Bun (Shape) labeled 'Conclusion'

Page 3 — Practice Area: Title 'My Paragraph' and use the Connector/Line tool to draw at least 3 horizontal lines for students to write on.

Note: You must use actual Shapes (rectangles/ellipses) for the burger parts and actual Lines for the writing area.
